parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the conditions required for two waves to be able to form a stationary wave.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: A stationary wave on a string has nodes and antinodes. The distance between a node and an adjacent antinode is $6.0\text{ cm}$.
parts.text: State what is meant by a node.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the wavelength of the two waves forming the stationary wave.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State the phase difference between the particles at two adjacent antinodes of the stationary wave.
